title: Rocky Road Fudge
hookLine: United States-inspired rocky road fudge with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Rocky Road Fudge
steps.instructionTemplate: Line an 8-inch-square baking pan with wax paper or foil, and coat with non-stick spray. Pour ½ cup of the miniature marshmallows into the bottom of the lined baking dish. In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and peanut butter. Microwave the chocolate mixture in 20-second intervals, stirring in between each interval, until the chocolate is melted. Incorporate {m52786_1}, {m52786_2}, {m52786_3}, and {m52786_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure miniature marshmallows first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Add the vanilla extract and stir well, until smooth. Reserve 2 tablespoons of the chopped almonds or peanuts, and set aside. Fold 1 ½ cups of the miniature marshmallows and the remaining chopped nuts into the chocolate mixture. Incorporate {m52786_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Chill Until Firmly Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer the chocolate mixture into the prepared pan and spread into an even layer. Immediately top with the reserved chopped nuts and the mallow bits or additional miniature marshmallows, if using. Refrigerate for 4 hours, or until set. Remove the fudge and wax paper from the pan. Carefully peel all of wax paper from the fudge.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Cut the fudge into bite-sized pieces and serve. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
